$comment: Package map from docs/architecture/01-overview.md. Source of truth for tools/gen/package.mjs, the workspace-shape test and .dependency-cruiser.mjs: dependsOn lists the only workspaces a package may import (the overview's 'May depend on' column); runtime picks the tsconfig lib/types (pure: ES only, dom: + DOM, node: + @types/node, mixed: both).

workspaces.name: @fluxion/schema
workspaces.desc: Zod 4 schemas and TS types for every record; IDs; validation errors; JSON Schema generation; migrations.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/geometry
workspaces.desc: Vectors, matrices, bezier/path ops, outline sampling, intersections, bounding boxes, spatial index wrappers.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/core
workspaces.desc: Document store (records + signals), transactions, commands, undo/redo, queries, registries.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/theme
workspaces.desc: Token model (DTCG), token resolution, palette generation (OKLCH), contrast checks, CSS-variable emission.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/layout
workspaces.desc: Layout interface, built-in algorithms, worker host, constraint/overlap pass, text-measure port.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/routing
workspaces.desc: Router interface, straight/bezier/orthogonal A* routers, anchor selection, nudging, hops, label placement.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/anim
workspaces.desc: Animation, timeline and interaction model evaluation: sampling at time t, build-state reduction, morph, rider LUTs, expressions.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/format
workspaces.desc: .flux zip, .flux.html and .flux.json read/write, content-addressed asset store, sanitizers, lockfile.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/dsl
workspaces.desc: FluxScript parser, compiler, decompiler, diagnostics, Mermaid/Markdown importers.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/render
workspaces.desc: React 19 DOM+SVG renderer of a screen, identical in edit and present mode.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/player
workspaces.desc: Present runtime: navigation, clock and scheduler, transitions, trigger bus, interactions, overlays, responsive, speaker sync.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/editor
workspaces.desc: Edit overlay, tools state machine, panels, inspector, library, timeline and interaction editors, AI panel.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/sdk
workspaces.desc: Public plugin API: stable contracts, manifest schema, component contract, test harness.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/cli
workspaces.desc: The fluxion command: validate, compile, render, lint, layout, convert, catalog, pack, site build.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/mcp
workspaces.desc: MCP server exposing the same operations as the CLI to AI agents.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/exporters
workspaces.desc: PDF/PNG/SVG/PPTX/video/site exporters.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/studio
workspaces.desc: Vite PWA: editor + player shell, file handling, provider adapters.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/docs
workspaces.desc: Astro Starlight documentation site and llms.txt.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/pack-basic
workspaces.desc: First-party basic shape pack; imports only `@fluxion/sdk`.

workspaces.name: @fluxion/pack-themes-core
workspaces.desc: First-party themes pack: eight built-in themes (FR-THM-003); imports only `@fluxion/sdk`.
